svg.text: Doppel: outbound GTM system, end to end
svg.textArea: Design v1 for a GTME cohort exercise, built from public data. Not run by Doppel. Source: context/docs/gtm-system.md. Row 1 reads left to right, row 2 right to left, row 3 left to right.
svg.text: 2 Find the people and check the email

rect.data-content:
1A Context OS
ICP, personas, signal matrix, research, learnings

1B Buying signals
• S1 new lookalike domain
• S2 public scam warning
• S3 Google ad on the brand name from another advertiser
• S4 regulator alert
• S5 app using the brand name from another developer

1D Find companies
• Clay Find Companies
• Segments A to D
• HQ in the US, Canada or Australia
• Refreshed monthly
• Plus firms named in S4 alerts

1E Enrich
• Headcount, country, segment
• Brand exposure flags
• S6 hiring, S7 new CISO, S8 KnowBe4
Log fail reason, or hold for review

1G Route
• Signal sets the opener
• Segment sets the lead product
• Matrix cell sets the angle
• S4 alert: economic buyer first

2A Investment and holding
Brand and Exec Protection

2E Find people
Champion, economic buyer, influencer. Up to 3 per account

2H Find and verify email
Clay waterfall plus a second verifier

3B Sequence
• Emails on days 1, 4, 9, 14
• LinkedIn on days 2 and 6
• EmailBison, HeyReach (proposed)

3C Handle replies
AI drafts the label, a human confirms

3E Weekly review
Results by workflow, signal, angle cell, persona and size tag
Weekly loop: results update the Context OS
